description: Attio CRM with REST API, App SDK and MCP, authenticated by workspace access tokens.
auth_notes: Workspace admins generate scoped access tokens (called API keys) that do not expire; OAuth for apps not shown in excerpts.
gate_detail: Token generation is available on all plans but requires a workspace admin. Start-for-free signup exists on the site. Sandbox not described.
api_scope: REST API and App SDK for reading, creating and updating workspace data, with webhook reference docs; also an Attio MCP.
mcp_notes: Attio developer platform lists Attio MCP; docs navigation has an MCP section; URL not given.

evidence.quote: API keys allow you to connect external tools and services to your workspace with secure, scoped access.
Tokens do not expire, but can be deleted at any time.
Connect your GTM stack with the REST API, App SDK, or Attio MCP.

uncertainties: OAuth support for third-party apps not visible in excerpts
Webhook evidence is only a docs tag count
